data.title: BlackRock files for PBIT: a Bitcoin ETF that limits your losses but caps your upside  "BlackRock wants to launch a Bitcoin fund that limits your losses. What's the catch? It limits your upside. There's no free lunch here."  "They have proposed an ETF called PBIT. This is not new, there are others, and this is very common outside the Bitcoin space."
